item.title: 302-Powered 1960 Ford F-100 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1960 Ford F-100 Styleside pickup was said to have spent all of its time in Texas under the care of a single family before the seller's 2024 purchase and subsequent refurbishment. A 302ci V8 and a four-speed automatic transmission were installed, and the truck was repainted in two-tone turquoise and white over a matching leather interior. item.title: Ex–Abarth & Cie 1965 Fiat-Abarth 1000 TC Berlina Corsa
item.description: This 1965 Fiat Abarth 1000 TC Berlina Corsa is noted to have been campaigned through the 1960s with the factory Abarth & Cie team, including by Arturo Merzario in the 1968 and 1969 runnings of the Four Hours of Monza. Following the 1970 season, chassis 210-1651 is said to have been put on display at various exhibits before being relocated in the late 1980s to South Africa, where it participated in various vintage racing events. item.title: 1976 Porsche 930 Turbo Carrera Project
item.description: This 1976 Porsche 930 Turbo Carrera was purchased by the seller's family member in the 1970s and is a non-driving project that has remained in storage for approximately 39 years. Powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-six linked with a four-speed manual transaxle, the car is finished in Grand Prix White over tan leather upholstery. item.title: 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 Coupe 3LZ Z07
item.description: This 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 has 3,800 miles and was ordered new by the owner, who took delivery of the car via the Corvette Museum Delivery program. item.title: 383-Powered 1980 Avanti II
item.description: This 1980 Avanti II underwent refurbishment work that was completed in 2018, and it was acquired by its late owner after being offered on BaT in January 2024. Refurbishment work involved the adaptation of a custom-built chassis that is connected to adjustable coilovers, a four-link rear suspension, four-wheel disc brakes, and American Racing wheels. item.title: 1968 Lamborghini Islero
item.description: This 1968 Lamborghini Islero is the sixth of 125 first-series examples built during a single year of production and was completed in April 1968 before being delivered new via Socaria in Belgium the following month. Chassis 6027 underwent refurbishment work between 2020 and 2024 that included a repaint in its original shade of Bronzo Scuro as well as an overhaul of the 3.9-liter quad-cam V12. item.description: This 2008 Lamborghini Murciélago LP640 coupe is said to have been exhibited by Lamborghini to showcase their Ad Personam program, and it also participated at the Concorso Italiano event during Monterey Car Week in 2017 and 2018, where it was awarded second and first place, respectively.
